prior.qualification: Prior tested source/PID cleanup evidence remains immutable. This supplemental association finding limits admission of current source-lease planner integration.

findings.title: Transferred original source censuses are not paired to the fresh canonical selector coordinates
source_evidence: Source actor records original ordered censuses and item labels. _censuses authenticates original actor/ledger/root/items but does not compare a selected mapping or actual per-item roots.

Fresh planner snapshots current _KIND_DIR as its registry and derives each source via current canonical _source_item_dir. In source-lease branch it skips a fresh capture and later appends all original source_censuses without checking census.tree.root against that derived source or strictly pairing each item/census.

Stage _projection(index) selects plan._censuses[index+1].tree and builds output from that original tree. _copy_item checks overall source_root, stage container, item labels and overwrite; it copies tree.root/source directly and derives destination using current _dest_item_dir.

Plan currentness compares current _KIND_DIR to the fresh registry, so a mapping changed before fresh registry capture can remain consistently current while the transferred census still describes the earlier coordinate.
findings.conditional_consequence: If selected runtime mapping changes between actor capture and fresh planning, and the newly derived selected source exists, the structural plan/stage path does not reject the association mismatch: it can acknowledge the new mapping while retaining/projecting bytes from the old captured item. Native bytes and old-tree custody checks prove the old tree, not its correspondence to the new selector coordinate.
findings.assumptions: This requires a private in-process canonical mapping change, not an ordinary external input edit or evidence that a third party can change _KIND_DIR. Canonical mapping is normally static. The finding concerns the explicitly requested exact original selector/census association invariant, not broad hostile concurrent Python mutation support.
findings.required_change: Before accepting transferred censuses into the fresh plan, strictly pair their count/order with actual selected items and require every census.tree.root to equal the actual canonical source coordinate derived for that item. Preserve the original census/native objects and ledger debit. An additional stage-time coordinate/projection-root check can defend the same association before effects; binding the original selected mapping can provide an earlier explicit refusal.
findings.evidence_limit: Source-only control/data-flow conclusion. No maintained or bespoke test was run in this supplement; no actual publication, effect bypass, corruption or exploit is claimed.

execution.description: Read-only source inspection and current SHA256 checks only. Existing23 passing evidence does not exercise runtime selector/census reassociation.
